title: model.hpp — share K stores and defer completed-block conversion
summary: The K save now groups token rows into 16-token block work and can share that work with main helpers. Main joins all helpers before publishing token completion. [h/tron/models/model.hpp:3085–3143]

Full blocks write the VNNI layout directly. Blocks completed through shorter runs convert after the forward readers finish; hardware-scored operations skip this deferred conversion. [h/tron/models/model.hpp:3300–3340; h/tron/models/model.hpp:3420–3439; h/tron/models/model.hpp:1842–1847]

terms.name: K / KV
terms.meaning: Attention keys / attention keys and values. A KV head supplies one key row per token.

terms.name: token
terms.meaning: One model input or generated position represented by a token job.

terms.name: batch / minibatch
terms.meaning: A group of token jobs processed together through model layers.

terms.name: layer / pass
terms.meaning: A model computation stage / one execution of the forward schedule.

terms.name: page
terms.meaning: A KV page (64-token block) in the cache. Its K storage is divided into 16-token blocks.

terms.name: VNNI
terms.meaning: Vector Neural Network Instructions. Here the name denotes the K layout that arranges dimension pairs across token positions.

terms.name: row-major
terms.meaning: A layout that stores the values of each token/head row consecutively.

terms.name: bf16
terms.meaning: A 16-bit floating-point scalar format used for cached K values.

terms.name: DMA
terms.meaning: Direct memory access, used to transfer data between host storage and hardware.

terms.name: GOF
terms.meaning: The code name for a group of four tokens whose completed K/V data can be submitted together.

terms.name: ks / row_of
terms.meaning: The input K buffer / the local function that extracts one token/head row from it.

terms.name: slot / geometry
terms.meaning: A logical cache destination / the attention head count and head width used to access it.

terms.name: k_store_window / unit_start
terms.meaning: The shared-save coordination state / the item-index boundaries that define its work units.

terms.name: worker_ix / n_workers
terms.meaning: The participating worker index / the total count including main worker 0.

terms.name: pending_k_blocks_ / page::k_storage_ref
terms.meaning: Deferred conversion records / a captured physical storage offset and layout-state index.

terms.name: release / acquire
terms.meaning: Atomic memory-order operations that publish prior writes and make those writes visible to a matching reader.

terms.name: latch / count_down
terms.meaning: A completion counter used by waiting work / the operation that removes one outstanding contribution.

terms.name: WK roped
terms.meaning: The diagnostic record label for K values after positional rotation.

The latency figures are historical measurements quoted by the source comment. This document does not claim that a new benchmark was run. [h/tron/models/model.hpp:3091–3093]
